summary: Iteration 79 — Backend E2E validation of the Recon parse-heartbeat / malformed-CSV fix. Ran /api/recon/init -> chunk -> finalize -> poll over real HTTP for 4 CSV scenarios (well-formed transactions x200, malformed transactions with unterminated quote, transactions with a 1.5MB oversized field, well-formed customers x50) plus a heartbeat-advancement check on a 1000-row job. All 5 pytest cases PASSED. Every job reached status='done'; the malformed and oversized-field CSVs no longer crash the parse to 'failed'; heartbeat timestamps advance while the parse thread runs, so the 8-min stale-job watchdog will no longer falsely fail active jobs.
critical_code_review_comments: recon_routes.py is 724 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the parse helpers (_parse_transactions_csv / _parse_customers_csv / _parse_items_csv) into a recon_parsers.py module for future maintainability.

_parse_with_heartbeat busy-loops with await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=30); if the parse raises, task.result() re-raises correctly, but the heartbeat pump does NOT record the error phase before propagating — the outer _run_recon_job catches and calls _fail(), so behaviour is correct, just worth a comment.

In _parse_transactions_csv the guarded 'except Exception' after next(row_iter) is intentional to catch csv.Error mid-iteration; the module-level csv.field_size_limit bump plus this guard together neutralise the two known failure modes (oversized field, unterminated quote). Validated end-to-end.

seed_data_creation: Each test uploads a synthetic CSV with TEST79-prefixed bill numbers / mobiles so it does not collide with real data. Bill numbers won't exist in DB so they show as missing_in_db in the report, but the recon completes normally. No cleanup of recon_jobs rows was done (not mandatory per instructions); the uploaded chunks are auto-deleted by _run_recon_job's finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for the recon parse-heartbeat fix lives at /app/backend/tests/iteration79_recon_parse_heartbeat_test.py — 5 tests, ~15s total. Reuse for any future recon changes. Previous iterations 74/75/76 covered OOM and streaming issues; 79 specifically covers parse-thread heartbeat and CSV error resilience.
rca of the issue: P0 recon stall RCA: CSV parse ran inside asyncio.to_thread with no heartbeat emission — a large-file parse taking >8min triggered the stale-job watchdog which set status=failed. Separately, malformed rows (unterminated quotes, oversized fields) raised csv.Error and aborted the entire parse. Fix (in /app/backend/routes/recon_routes.py, verified working): (a) module-level csv.field_size_limit raised to sys.maxsize; (b) new _parse_with_heartbeat wraps to_thread and pumps _heartbeat(phase='parsing') every 30s while parse is running; (c) the three parse functions now iterate with a guarded 'while True: next(row_iter)' loop that catches csv.Error / mapper exceptions and increments parse_failed instead of aborting. E2E confirms all four scenarios now reach status='done'.
